scripts.text:
[Dewata Sailor]
Do you want to visit ^8B4513Dewata Island^000000?
With its dazzling waves and charming vistas it's a great place to relax.
The transit fee is 10,000 Zeny and 1,000 for VIP.
scripts.translation:
[德瓦他水手]
您想去^8B4513德瓦他島^000000嗎？
那裡有著迷人的海浪和風景，是放鬆身心的好地方。
中轉費用為10,000 Zeny，VIP費用為1,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Dewata Sailor]
Do you want to visit ^8B4513Dewata Island^000000?
With its dazzling waves and charming vistas it's a great place to relax.
The transit fee is 10,000 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[德瓦他水手]
您想去^8B4513德瓦他島^000000嗎？
那裡有著迷人的海浪和風景，是放鬆身心的好地方。
中轉費用為10,000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Yes!
scripts.translation: 準備好了！

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Dewata Sailor]
^8B4513Dewata^000000 is a beautiful and peaceful island country.
Have a nice trip~
scripts.translation:
[德瓦他水手]
^8B4513德瓦他^000000是一個美麗而寧靜的島國。
祝您旅途愉快~

scripts.text:
[Dewata Sailor]
You don't have the dough, kid.
Come back when you have a bigger wallet.
scripts.translation:
[德瓦他水手]
你的錢不夠啊，小鬼。
等你錢包鼓一點再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Dewata Sailor]
Let me know
when you're ready to travel~
scripts.translation:
[德瓦他水手]
準備好出發了就告訴我~

scripts.text:
[Alberta Sailor]
Do you want to go back to Alberta?
scripts.translation:
[艾爾貝塔水手]
您想回到艾爾貝塔嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Alberta Sailor]
I hope you had a lot of fun on
your trip to ^8B4513Dewata^000000 Island.
Please come again!
scripts.translation:
[艾爾貝塔水手]
希望您能在^8B4513德瓦他^000000島玩得開心。
歡迎再次光臨！

scripts.text:
[Alberta Sailor]
Have some more fun before you go.
^8B4513Dewata^000000 Island still has more to offer.
scripts.translation:
[艾爾貝塔水手]
走之前再多玩一會兒吧。
^8B4513德瓦他^000000島還有很多值得探索的地方。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
What's wrong with your faaaaaace? You must really be clueless!
scripts.translation:
[水果愛好者]
你的臉怎麼了？看來你真的很無知啊！

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
Let me drop some knowledge on ya.
scripts.translation:
[水果愛好者]
讓我給你普及點知識吧。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
I may be a youngling, but no one knows more than I do about ^777700Palm fruit^000000. All right! What do you want to know?
scripts.translation:
[水果愛好者]
雖然我年紀小，但關於^777700棕櫚果^000000，沒人比我更懂。說吧！你想了解什麼？

scripts.text: About the shell...
scripts.translation: 關於果殼...

scripts.text: About the pulp...
scripts.translation: 關於果肉...

scripts.text: About the palm kernel...
scripts.translation: 關於棕櫚仁...

scripts.text: No thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
So you want to know about Palm fruit's pulp? Let me explain.
scripts.translation:
[水果愛好者]
你想了解棕櫚果的果肉？讓我來解釋一下。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
Normally Palm fruit shell is used for making oil. Palm Oil is a useful ingredient for many dishes.
scripts.translation:
[水果愛好者]
通常棕櫚果的果殼用來榨油。棕櫚油是許多菜餚的有用原料。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
Hmm... Have you met Memo already? Then it should be easy for you to understand.
scripts.translation:
[水果愛好者]
嗯...你見過備忘嗎？如果是那樣，你應該很容易理解。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
If you want to know how to use Palm Oil, go find Memo on the north side of Dewata island. Everyday, he makes traditional drinks with Palm Oil.
scripts.translation:
[水果愛好者]
如果你想知道如何使用棕櫚油，去德瓦他島北邊找備忘。他每天都會用棕櫚油製作傳統飲品。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
Anyways, we refer to the oil that comes from the Palm fruit as Palm oil or Coconut oil, which is well known for it's quality.
scripts.translation:
[水果愛好者]
總之，我們從棕櫚果中提取的油被稱為棕櫚油或椰子油，以品質優良而聞名。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
The leftovers from oil production gets dried, and used for fuel in cooking or heating.
scripts.translation:
[水果愛好者]
榨油後的殘渣會被曬乾，用作烹飪或取暖的燃料。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
It burns well and has a good smell, can't get better than that.
scripts.translation:
[水果愛好者]
燃燒效果很好，而且聞起來很香，簡直完美。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
Ok!! That is all about the pulp, it takes too long to explain all those useful effects for Palm fruit shells.
scripts.translation:
[水果愛好者]
好了！關於果肉的介紹就到這裡，要講完棕櫚果殼的所有用途可太花時間了。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
It's not like this is the extent of my knowledge. Don't get me wrong!
scripts.translation:
[水果愛好者]
別誤會，我的知識可不止這些！

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
So you want to know about the Palm interior? Let me explain.
scripts.translation:
[水果愛好者]
那麼，你想了解棕櫚果的內部嗎？讓我來解釋一下。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
Palm tree fruit has 2 layers of pulp. Outside is very rough, and the inside is smooth...
scripts.translation:
[水果愛好者]
棕櫚果的果肉分為兩層。外層非常粗糙，而內層則很光滑...

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
Hmm... Yes! the pulp of Palm tree fruit is a little bit harder than a walnut shell, must be the water it contains inside.
scripts.translation:
[水果愛好者]
嗯...是的！棕櫚果的果肉比核桃殼稍微硬一點，這大概是因為裡面含有水分吧。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
Inside of the shell, there's about 300cc water which is useful in quenching people's thirst since Dewata island has very hot weather.
scripts.translation:
[水果愛好者]
果殼裡面大約有300cc的水，在德瓦他這樣炎熱的天氣裡，用來解渴非常有用。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
And it's not like we just throw it away once we drink the water inside!!
scripts.translation:
[水果愛好者]
而且，喝完裡面的水後，我們可不會直接把它扔掉！！

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
We also can make a quality canteen out of it! Like I said, it has really thick outer shell enough and can act as a water bottle.
scripts.translation:
[水果愛好者]
我們還能用它製作優質的水壺！就像我說的，它的外殼足夠厚實，完全可以當作水瓶使用。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
It is also great to make charcoal. Charcoal made out of palm fruit is well known for long lasting and quality fire,
scripts.translation:
[水果愛好者]
它也非常適合製作木炭。用棕櫚果製成的木炭以燃燒持久、品質優良而聞名。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
People love to cook seafoods and chicken with Palm fruit charcoal..
scripts.translation:
[水果愛好者]
人們喜歡用棕櫚果木炭來烤海鮮和雞肉...

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
It has the extra bonus of being burning with a pleasant palm smell
scripts.translation:
[水果愛好者]
它還有一個額外的優點，就是燃燒時會散發出宜人的棕櫚香味。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
Ok!! That is all for pulp information, it takes too long to explain all those useful effects.
scripts.translation:
[水果愛好者]
好了！關於果肉的介紹就到這裡，要講完所有用途可太花時間了。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
It's not like this is all I know. Don't get me wrong!
scripts.translation:
[水果愛好者]
別誤會，我知道的可不止這些！

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
So, you want to know about tender kernel inside? Let me explain for you
scripts.translation:
[水果愛好者]
那麼，你想了解裡面柔軟的果核嗎？讓我為你解釋一下。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
The kernel inside of the hard pulp is used as a natural digestive.
scripts.translation:
[水果愛好者]
堅硬果肉裡面的果核，被用作天然的助消化劑。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
Not much to say about the kernel inside..
scripts.translation:
[水果愛好者]
關於裡面的果核，也沒什麼好說的...

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
but we do make sure to use every part of the palm fruit.
scripts.translation:
[水果愛好者]
但我們確實會利用棕櫚果的每一部分。

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
Wouldn't you agree?
scripts.translation:
[水果愛好者]
你不覺得是這樣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Fruit Fancier]
Arrgg! You have no interest in the world!
scripts.translation:
[水果愛好者]
啊！你對這個世界毫無興趣！

scripts.text:
[Lazy Young Man]
Why are you carrying so much? Isn't it heavy?
scripts.translation:
[懶散的年輕人]
你背了這麼多東西？不重嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lazy Young Man]
Wewt~!! Isn't that Palm Juice?
Can you give me that? I just woke
up, and my throat is parched!
scripts.translation:
[懶散的年輕人]
哇~！！那不是棕櫚汁嗎？
能給我喝一點嗎？我剛睡醒，嗓子幹得要命！

scripts.text: Give
scripts.translation: 給他

scripts.text: Do not give
scripts.translation: 不給

scripts.text:
[Lazy Young Man]
Really? For me?? I'll give you this in return... Thanks... Hehe~
scripts.translation:
[懶散的年輕人]
真的嗎？給我？那我回贈你一點這個... 謝謝... 嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Lazy Young Man]
So be it~ Ok...
scripts.translation:
[懶散的年輕人]
好吧~ 行吧...

scripts.text:
[Lazy Young Man]
Ah~ Thristy~ Anyone have some Palm
juice for me?~
scripts.translation:
[懶散的年輕人]
啊~ 好渴~ 誰有棕櫚汁給我喝一點？~

scripts.text:
[Lazy Young Man]
Arrgg~ I'm thirsty~~ so thirsty~~
Give me Palm juice... Palm Juuiice~~
scripts.translation:
[懶散的年輕人]
啊~ 好渴~~ 太渴了~~
給我點棕櫚汁... 棕櫚汁~~

scripts.text:
[Nasolo]
Wow~ Pure ocean, a warm beach...
Perfect for a date with a girlfriend...
scripts.translation:
[納索洛]
哇~ 純淨的海洋，溫暖的海灘...
簡直太適合和女朋友約會了...

scripts.text:
[Nasolo]
If only I had one...
scripts.translation:
[納索洛]
要是我也有一個就好了...

scripts.text:
[Nasolo]
I wonder when my princess will come...
scripts.translation:
[納索洛]
不知道我的公主什麼時候會來...

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
You came to taste my dish? It is always good to eat with an empty stomach.
scripts.translation:
[餐館老闆]
你是來品嚐我的菜的嗎？空腹吃東西總是最棒的。

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
Welcome to the island of Dewata.
I hope you behave like a noble
traveler, unlike some of these
teenage punks...
scripts.translation:
[餐館老闆]
歡迎來到德瓦他島。
希望你能像高貴的旅行者那樣舉止得體，
別像這裡那些朽魔一樣...

scripts.text: About Dewata dishes
scripts.translation: 關於德瓦他料理

scripts.text: Today's menu?
scripts.translation: 今天的選單？

scripts.text: I'm okay.
scripts.translation: 我沒事

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
Need info about our foods? Well... I don't have much to talk about, but feel free to listen if you want.
scripts.translation:
[餐館老闆]
需要了解我們的食物嗎？嗯... 也沒什麼好說的，但如果你想聽，請便。

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
So much to cover, let me begin.
scripts.translation:
[餐館老闆]
內容很多，讓我從頭說起。

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
First, Dewata dishes have special names based on each cooking recipe,
scripts.translation:
[餐館老闆]
首先，德瓦他料理會根據每種烹飪方法擁有特殊的名稱，

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
If dish name has 'Goreng' in it, then it is either stir or deep fried food.
scripts.translation:
[餐館老闆]
如果菜名裡有“Goreng”，那就是炒或炸的食物。

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
If it is a type of 'Bakar', then it is a grilled food.
scripts.translation:
[餐館老闆]
如果是“Bakar”類的，那就是烤制的食物。

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
And if it's 'Satay', then you are eating a skewered dish.
scripts.translation:
[餐館老闆]
如果是“Satay”，那就是串燒料理。

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
Second, we have dishes named after basic ingredients,
scripts.translation:
[餐館老闆]
其次，我們有些料理是以基本食材命名的，

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
In Dewata island, we call rice as Nasi, noodle as Mie, bread as Roti, chicken as Ayam, fish as Ikan, and corn as Jagung.
scripts.translation:
[餐館老闆]
在德瓦他島上，我們稱米飯為Nasi，麵條為Mie，麵包為Roti，雞肉為Ayam，魚為Ikan，玉米為Jagung。

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
So, if rice is fried we call it 'Nasi Goreng', and fried noodle is 'Mie Goreng'.
scripts.translation:
[餐館老闆]
所以，炒米飯叫“Nasi Goreng”，炒麵叫“Mie Goreng”。

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
Well... This is enough to enjoy our foods in Dewata!! If you are hungry, we have our special set menu for only ^0000FF5000^000000 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[餐館老闆]
嗯... 這就足夠讓您在德瓦他盡享美食了！！如果您餓了，我們有特價套餐，僅需^0000FF5000^000000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
We have 2 items 'Nasi Goreng' and 'Satay'. Which one do you want?
scripts.translation:
[餐館老闆]
我們有兩種菜品：“Nasi Goreng”和“Satay”。您想要哪一種？

scripts.text: Nasi Goreng
scripts.translation: Nasi Goreng

scripts.text: Satay
scripts.translation: Satay

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
This is Nasi Goreng fried with my special sauce plus egg fry on the top. It only costs ^0000FF5000^000000 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[餐館老闆]
這是用我的特製醬汁炒制的Nasi Goreng，上面還煎了一個蛋。只要^0000FF5000^000000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
This is the Satay, a slice of meat skewered and grilled over Palm fruit charcoal. It costs only ^0000FF5000^000000 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[餐館老闆]
這是Satay，肉片串在籤子上，用棕櫚果炭火烤制。只要^0000FF5000^000000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Taste
scripts.translation: 品嚐

scripts.text: Walk away
scripts.translation: 離開

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
Where's the money kid? Sheesh! No free food here! Ok?
scripts.translation:
[餐館老闆]
錢呢，小孩？天哪！這裡沒有免費的食物！懂嗎？

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
Here's your {0}, you won't regret it!
scripts.translation:
[餐館老闆]
這是您的{0}，您不會後悔的！

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
It's a shame you won't taste this great dish...
scripts.translation:
[餐館老闆]
真遺憾，您嘗不到這道美味佳餚...

scripts.text:
[Restauranteur]
Are you serious? This is not even funny.
scripts.translation:
[餐館老闆]
你是認真的嗎？這一點都不好笑。

scripts.text:
[Gourmet]
Oh... it's like a party in my
mouth... and everyone's invited!
scripts.translation:
[美食家]
噢... 就像嘴裡開了一場派對...
而且所有人都被邀請了！

scripts.text:
[Gourmet]
Master~ One more please~
scripts.translation:
[美食家]
師父~ 再來一份~

scripts.text:
[Gourmet]
You must try this! The Food here is succulent~
scripts.translation:
[美食家]
你一定要嚐嚐！這裡的食物鮮嫩多汁~

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Wow...
How many has he already eaten?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
哇...
他已經吃了多少了？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
He must be big eater, not the gourmet...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
他肯定是個大胃王，而不是美食家...

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Have you been to Prontera yet? I think I've seen him somewhere..
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
你去過普隆德拉嗎？我覺得我在哪裡見過他...

scripts.text:
[Guide]
This temple behind me is called Borobudur.
Borobudur temple was built in the 9th century
to venerate the Great Buddha, an ancient religious figure.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
我身後的這座寺廟叫做婆羅浮屠。
婆羅浮屠建於9世紀，用於供奉大佛，一位古老的宗教人物。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
This temple is made with 6 square platforms and 3 round platforms, and 2672 hand carved relief panels as well as 504 statue of various Buddhas.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
這座寺廟由6個方形平臺和3個圓形平臺組成，還有2672塊手工雕刻的浮雕面板，以及504尊各種佛像。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
The central stupa, or shrine is located at the center of high platform, which is surrounded by 72 more statues.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
中央的佛塔，也就是神龕，位於最高平臺的中心，周圍環繞著72尊雕像。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Even in modern times Borobudur temple is a pilgrimage site for many monks worshiping the Buddha. It's also a major tourist attraction, as you can imagine.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
即使在現代，婆羅浮屠寺廟也是許多供奉佛陀的武僧的朝聖地。正如你可以想像的那樣，它也是一個主要的旅遊景點。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
That is all I have on Borobudur temple, are there any questions?
If not, we can move to the next spot.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
關於婆羅浮屠寺廟，我就介紹到這裡了，有什麼問題嗎？
如果沒有，我們可以去下一個景點了。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Oh, dag-nabbit... I've gone and
picked the wrong tour guide...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
噢，該死...我選錯了嚮導...

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
This hombre is a real snooze...
Why make it longer..
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
這傢伙真讓人犯困...
為什麼要說這麼多...

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I need to change my travel agent...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我得換個旅行代理...

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hey, let's go there! Hurry up,
while the tour guide is explaining~
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
嘿，我們去那邊吧！快點，趁嚮導還在講解~

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Come on... It doesn't sound like
he's going to stop talking anytime soon.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
拜託...聽起來他一時半會兒不會停下來的。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Aren't we going to get lost without the guide?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
沒有嚮導我們不會迷路嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
We got lost already last time...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
上次我們就迷路了...

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Oh~ This is very interesting. A
temple that worships the Buddha...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
噢~ 這很有趣。一座供奉佛陀的寺廟...

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
But I don't really get all the
symbology here.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
但我並不太懂這裡的象徵意義。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
So beautiful... I wonder who built
this place?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
真美...不知道是誰建造了這個地方？

scripts.text:
[Monk]
I am a monk, content to spend my days in religious study.
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
我是一名武僧，樂於在宗教研究中度過我的日子。

scripts.text:
[Monk]
I've just returned from a pilgrimage to Borobudur temple with my fellow monks...
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
我剛和同門的武僧們一起從婆羅浮屠寺廟朝聖回來...

scripts.text:
[Monk]
Borobudur temple has many pilgrims visiting, since it is one of few temples left for worshipping the Great Buddha.
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
婆羅浮屠寺廟有很多朝聖者來訪，因為它是少數幾個供奉大佛的寺廟之一。

scripts.text:
[Monk]
Borobudur temple is one of few temples left for worshiping the Great Buddha.
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
婆羅浮屠寺廟是少數幾個供奉大佛的寺廟之一。

scripts.text:
[Monk]
I don't understand why there are only few temples left that follow our ways...
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
我不明白，為什麼遵循我們教義的寺廟只剩下這麼少了...

scripts.text:
[Monk]
Are you a Tourist? You can make an offering and a wish to one of the shrines.
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
你是遊客嗎？你可以向神龕供奉並許下願望。

scripts.text:
[Monk]
Our great Buddha may grant your wish..
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
我們的大佛可能會實現你的願望。

scripts.text:
[Monk]
Our great Buddha is the king of souls and the leader of all good Gods.
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
我們的大佛是眾靈之王，也是所有善神的領袖。

scripts.text:
[Monk]
The Dewata tribes believes in Buddha, the strange thing is they all describe Buddha as different creatures.
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
德瓦他部落信仰佛陀，奇怪的是，他們都將佛陀描述成不同的生物。

scripts.text:
[Monk]
I'm not really sure about the reason for that. Maybe because there are many different tribes in Dewata with different characteristics.
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
我不太清楚原因。也許是因為德瓦他有許多不同的部落，各自有著不同的特徵。

scripts.text: There is a small shrine here. There are many people making wishes.
scripts.translation: 這裡有一座小神龕。有許多人在許願。

scripts.text: Make a donation.
scripts.translation: 進行捐贈

scripts.text: Make a wish.
scripts.translation: 許下願望

scripts.text: Walk away.
scripts.translation: 離開

scripts.text:
Donation case says:
^FF00001,000 ~ 100,000 Zeny^000000
How much do you want to donate?
scripts.translation:
捐贈箱上寫著：
^FF00001,000 ~ 100,000 Zeny^000000
您想捐贈多少？

scripts.text: - Cancelled. -
scripts.translation: - 已取消。-

scripts.text: - Not enough Zeny. -
scripts.translation: - Zeny不足。-

scripts.text: What is your wish?
scripts.translation: 您的願望是什麼？

scripts.text: You make a wish for ^0000FF{0}^000000 to the small shrine.
scripts.translation: 您向小神龕許下了^0000FF{0}^000000的願望。

scripts.text: - A celestial entity gives you a blessing. -
scripts.translation: - 一個天界實體賜予了您祝福。-

scripts.text: - The shrine envelops you in a loving aura. -
scripts.translation: - 神龕將您籠罩在充滿愛意的靈氣中。-

scripts.text: It feels like this wish could come true.
scripts.translation: 感覺這個願望可能會實現。

scripts.text: What is your wish?
scripts.translation: 您的願望是什麼？

scripts.text: You have made your wish for ^0000FF{0}^000000 to the small shrine.
scripts.translation: 您已向小神龕許下^0000FF{0}^000000的願望。

scripts.text: It feels like this wish could come true.
scripts.translation: 感覺這個願望可能會實現。

scripts.text: Mysterious energy comes out from the shrine.
scripts.translation: 神秘的能量從神龕中散發出來。

scripts.text: You have received the shrine's blessing.
scripts.translation: 您獲得了神龕的祝福。

scripts.text:
[Monk]
You are a stranger here. What brings here to this quiet place?
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
您是這裡的陌生人吧。是什麼風把您吹到這寧靜的地方來了？

scripts.text: I'm sightseeing.
scripts.translation: 我在觀光

scripts.text: No reason.
scripts.translation: 沒什麼特別的原因

scripts.text:
[Monk]
Oh, you are a tourist. This is the '^0000FFPagoda^000000' worshiping the great Buddha. Please be respectful of the monks praying here.
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
哦，原來您是遊客。這裡是供奉大佛的^0000FF寶塔^000000。請尊重在此祈禱的僧侶們。

scripts.text:
[Monk]
Good day to you...
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
祝您有美好的一天...

scripts.text:
[Monk]
We have a pagoda for the worship of Buddhas. Each temple has one of these towers, though not many people come here besides other monks.
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
我們有一座供奉佛陀的寶塔。每座寺廟都有這樣一座塔，不過除了其他僧侶外，很少有外人會來這裡。

scripts.text: I see...
scripts.translation: 我明白了...

scripts.text: Explain about Buddhas
scripts.translation: 講講佛陀

scripts.text: Ah, okay.
scripts.translation: 好的，我明白了

scripts.text:
[Monk]
You must feel the compassion of our Buddha!
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
您必須感受我們佛陀的慈悲！

scripts.text:
[Monk]
Buddha is our God from Dewata myth, he is the king of souls and also the leader of good Gods.
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
佛陀是德瓦他神話中的神明，他是眾靈之王，也是眾善神的領袖。

scripts.text:
[Monk]
Buddha is the guardian of souls whom often described in traditional dance as fighting against the magician Rangda.
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
佛陀是靈魂的守護者，在傳統舞蹈中，他常被描繪為與魔法師朗達戰鬥的形象。

scripts.text:
[Monk]
In Dewata we belive there are many deities protecting each island and tribal locale,
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
在德瓦他，我們相信有許多神靈守護著每個島嶼和部落地區，

scripts.text:
[Monk]
so we do have different manifestations of the Buddha, usually described as a bear, tiger, dragon, snake, or lion
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
因此我們有不同形態的佛陀，通常被描述為熊、虎、龍、蛇或獅子。

scripts.text:
[Monk]
Great Lion is one of famous Buddhas worshipped in Dewata.
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
大獅子是德瓦他供奉的著名佛陀之一。

scripts.text:
[Monk]
Hope this was good explanation for you. Let me know if you have anything else you want to know.
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
希望這個解釋對您有幫助。如果您還有其他想知道的，請告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Monk]
Good day to you...
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
祝您有美好的一天...

scripts.text:
[Monk]
This tower is built on the edge of coastal cliff. You can pray with a cool ocean breeze in your hair.
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
這座塔建在海邊的懸崖邊緣。您可以在海風中祈禱，感受清涼的海風拂過髮梢。

scripts.text:
[Monk]
Come, you should feel the compassion of our Buddha in this pleasant weather.
scripts.translation:
[武僧]
來吧，在這宜人的天氣裡，您應該能感受到我們佛陀的慈悲。

scripts.text:
[Lodge Owner]
These days, we have many honeymooners visiting here.
scripts.translation:
[旅舍老闆]
最近，我們這裡有很多度蜜月的情侶來訪。

scripts.text:
[Lodge Owner]
It must be the beautiful scenery, right?
scripts.translation:
[旅舍老闆]
一定是因為這裡美麗的風景吧？

scripts.text:
[Lodge Owner]
I'm happy with my business. Hope all we have a lot more visitors like that.
scripts.translation:
[旅舍老闆]
我的生意興隆，真高興。
希望我們這裡能迎來更多像他們一樣的客人。

scripts.text:
[Lodge Owner]
Ah! You should bring your lover to Dewata on your honeymoon.
I'll give you a good price-
scripts.translation:
[旅舍老闆]
啊！您蜜月的時候應該帶您的愛人來德瓦他。
我會給您一個優惠的價格——

scripts.text:
[Lodge employee]
Argg~ This is really ticking me off!
scripts.translation:
[旅舍員工]
啊~ 這真的讓我很惱火！

scripts.text:
[Lodge employee]
How come more and more couples come here?
scripts.translation:
[旅舍員工]
為什麼越來越多的情侶來這裡？

scripts.text:
[Lodge employee]
And why do they have act so lovey-dovey? What's up with that?
scripts.translation:
[旅舍員工]
而且他們為什麼非要表現得那麼膩歪？這到底是怎麼回事？

scripts.text:
[Lodge employee]
C'mon, show some respect to the people who work here...
scripts.translation:
[旅舍員工]
拜託了，請尊重一下在這裡工作的人...

scripts.text:
[Sweet Husband]
You are the most beautiful thing in the world baby~
scripts.translation:
[恩愛的夫婦]
寶貝，你是世界上最美麗的人~

scripts.text:
[Sweet Wife]
Really? I'm that beautiful? I love you, honey~
scripts.translation:
[恩愛的夫婦]
真的嗎？我那麼美嗎？我愛你，親愛的~

scripts.text:
[Sweet Married Couple]
Hahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahaha
Hohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohoho
scripts.translation:
[恩愛的夫婦]
哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈
呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵

scripts.text: Come on now, I'm growing tired of this. Let's go.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，我有點累了。我們走吧。

scripts.text:
[Sweet Wife]
Baby~ You know what flower that is~?
scripts.translation:
[溫柔的妻子]
親愛的~你知道那是什麼花嗎~？

scripts.text:
[Sweet Husband]
Hmm? I don't know. But it's really pretty.
scripts.translation:
[體貼的丈夫]
嗯？我不知道。但它真的很漂亮。

scripts.text:
[Sweet Wife]
Baby~ Who's prettier, me or the flower?
scripts.translation:
[溫柔的妻子]
親愛的~我和花，誰更漂亮呢？

scripts.text:
[Sweet Husband]
No matter how pretty the flower is, you are always more beautiful~
scripts.translation:
[體貼的丈夫]
無論花多漂亮，你永遠是最美的~

scripts.text:
[Sweet Wife]
Really? I'm that pretty? I love you, sweetie~
scripts.translation:
[溫柔的妻子]
真的嗎？我那麼漂亮嗎？親愛的，我愛你~

scripts.text:
[Sweet Married Couple]
Hahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahahaha
Hohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohohoho
scripts.translation:
[恩愛的夫婦]
哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈
呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵呵

scripts.text: Come on now, this bores me. Let's move on.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，真無聊。我們走吧。

scripts.text:
[Reclining Tourist]
Wow~ This is really comfy~
scripts.translation:
[躺著的遊客]
哇~這裡真舒服~

scripts.text:
[Reclining Tourist]
I'm having a great time just relaxing.
scripts.translation:
[躺著的遊客]
我就在這裡放鬆，感覺棒極了。

scripts.text:
[Reclining Tourist]
You should lie down here too.
Once you do, you'll never want to get up.
scripts.translation:
[躺著的遊客]
你也應該躺在這裡。
一旦躺下，你就再也不想起來了。

scripts.text:
[Reclining Tourist]
That's why I haven't moved in a whole week! Hahahaha~
scripts.translation:
[躺著的遊客]
所以我整整一週都沒動過！哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Hey {0}, look at that man!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嘿 {0}，你看那個男人！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
He's been lying there for a week doin' nothin'...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
他就那麼躺在那裡，整整一週什麼都沒幹...

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Who IS that man?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
那個人到底是誰啊？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
I don't want to be a lazybones like him when I grow up.
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
我長大後不想變成像他那樣懶洋洋的人。

scripts.text:
[Sarr]
They're hiding so I should seek.
I'll find them for sure!-
scripts.translation:
[薩爾]
他們藏起來了，所以我要去找。
我一定會找到他們的！

scripts.text:
[Sarr]
One~
scripts.translation:
[薩爾]
一~

scripts.text:
[Sarr]
Two~ Three~
scripts.translation:
[薩爾]
二~ 三~

scripts.text:
[Sarr]
Four~ Five~ Six~
scripts.translation:
[薩爾]
四~ 五~ 六~

scripts.text:
[Sarr]
Ninty nine~ One hundred!!! Now I'm coming~
scripts.translation:
[薩爾]
九十九~ 一百！！！我來了哦~

scripts.text:
[Siyak]
Hey come on, move over~ He's gonna find me~~
scripts.translation:
[西雅克]
哎呀，快讓開~ 他要找到我了~~

scripts.text:
[Sarr]
I found Siyak!! Come out, come out!!
scripts.translation:
[薩爾]
我找到西雅克了！！出來吧，出來吧！！

scripts.text:
[Siyak]
Arrgg!! This is all your fault~!!
scripts.translation:
[西雅克]
啊嗚！！都怪你~！！

scripts.text:
[Sipo]
Sarr won't find me here, right?
scripts.translation:
[西波]
薩爾應該找不到我藏在這裡吧？

scripts.text:
[Sarr]
I found Siyak!! Come out come out!!
scripts.translation:
[薩爾]
我找到西雅克了！！出來吧，出來吧！！

scripts.text:
[Sipo]
Hehe~ Now Siyak is IT~ I'll just keep hiding in here.
scripts.translation:
[西波]
嘿嘿~ 現在輪到西雅克找了~ 我就繼續躲在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Majya]
I was playing hide-and-seek with my friends...
scripts.translation:
[瑪佳]
我和朋友們在玩捉迷藏...

scripts.text:
[Majya]
I've been just standing here, and they haven't found me for 3 hours...
scripts.translation:
[瑪佳]
我就一直站在這裡，他們三個小時都沒找到我...

scripts.text:
[Majya]
What should I do? Come out? I don't want to be IT...
scripts.translation:
[瑪佳]
我該怎麼辦？要出來嗎？我不想當找人的人...

scripts.text:
[Ukki]
WaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaa~
scripts.translation:
[烏基]
哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, kid...

[Ukki]
WaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaaWaa~
scripts.translation:
[烏基]
哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇哇~

scripts.text:
[Ukki]
Mama~ Papa~ Where are youuu~ Waa~
scripts.translation:
[烏基]
媽媽~ 爸爸~ 你們在哪裡呀~ 哇~

scripts.text:
[Mum]
Ukki~ Ukki~ Where did she go?
scripts.translation:
[媽媽]
烏基~ 烏基~ 她跑哪裡去了？

scripts.text:
[Mum]
I can't take my eyes of her for a second...
scripts.translation:
[媽媽]
我一刻都不能讓她離開我的視線...

scripts.text:
[Mum]
Ukki~
scripts.translation:
[媽媽]
烏基~

scripts.text:
[Poppa]
Honey, is Ukki lost again?
scripts.translation:
[爸爸]
親愛的，烏基又走丟了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Poppa]
Arrgg... I can't go anywhere with her... How many times already?
scripts.translation:
[爸爸]
啊...帶著她我哪裡都去不了...這已經是第幾次了？

scripts.text:
[Daddy]
She's gotten lost in Luoyang, Amatsu, Moscovia, Brasilis, Kunlun,
and in Ayothaya...
scripts.translation:
[爸爸]
她在洛陽、櫻花城、莫斯科比亞、巴西、崑崙，
還有哎喲泰雅都走丟過...

scripts.text:
[Daddy]
What!! It's already been 7 times including this time in Dewata... 7 times!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[爸爸]
什麼！！算上這次在德瓦他，已經7次了... 7次！！！！

scripts.text:
[Happily Married Grandpa]
Today, I should ask my lady to
cook me some ^006400fried rice^000000.
scripts.translation:
[幸福的老爺爺]
今天，我應該請我的夫人
給我做點^006400炒飯^000000。

scripts.text:
[Happily Married Grandpa]
My wife's ^006400fried rice^000000 is
always very special!
scripts.translation:
[幸福的老爺爺]
我夫人做的^006400炒飯^000000
總是非常特別！

scripts.text:
[Happily Married Grandpa]
It makes me love her even more.
You can't imagine the wonderful flavor!
scripts.translation:
[幸福的老爺爺]
這讓我更加愛她了。
你無法想像那美妙的味道！

scripts.text:
[Happily Married Grandma]
In my younger days,
there were many gentleman callers
who wanted to court me.
scripts.translation:
[幸福的老奶奶]
在我年輕的時候，
有很多追求者想向我求婚。

scripts.text:
[Happily Married Grandma]
Yet, I met just the right guy,
and got married.
I asked what he likes best
about me, he said it was
my homemade ^006400fried rice^000000
scripts.translation:
[幸福的老奶奶]
但我遇到了對的人，
並結為了夫妻。
我問他最喜歡我什麼，
他說是我做的^006400炒飯^000000

scripts.text:
[Happily Married Grandma]
And since then, he only asks me
to make ^006400fried rice^000000 for dinner.
Over 40 years of marriage
and he still doesn't get tired ot it.
scripts.translation:
[幸福的老奶奶]
從那以後，他晚餐只點^006400炒飯^000000。
結婚40多年了，
他依然吃不膩。

scripts.text:
[Happily Married Grandma]
I always think it was lucky
to be growing old with a guy
who loves what I cook.
scripts.translation:
[幸福的老奶奶]
我一直覺得，
能和一個喜歡我做的菜的人
一起變老，真是幸運。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Semangat]
I also traveled around the World
When I was young like you.
^FF0000Monkey, Cuttlefish^000000
^FF0000Eagle, and Snake^000000,
all were good friends I met
during my travels.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 塞曼加特]
我年輕時也像你們一樣
環遊過世界。
^FF0000猴子、烏賊^000000
^FF0000鷹和蛇^000000，
都是我在旅途中結識的好夥伴。

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Semangat]
I still have passion for adventure and traveling.
But, I can't just leave
my beloved wife and
grandchildren behind...
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 塞曼加特]
我依然對冒險和旅行充滿熱情。
但是，我不能就這樣拋下
我深愛的妻子和
孫輩們...

scripts.text:
[Adventurer Semangat]
You will also have something
or someone that is as precious
in your heart someday.
scripts.translation:
[冒險者 塞曼加特]
總有一天，你心中也會擁有
像他們一樣珍貴的人或事物。

scripts.text:
[Semangat's Wife]
Where's that old man
gone off to again?
Have you seen my husband around?
scripts.translation:
[塞曼加特的妻子]
那個老頭子又跑哪去了？
你看到我丈夫了嗎？

scripts.text: I think I saw him there..
scripts.translation: 我好像在那邊看到他了。

scripts.text: No I haven't..
scripts.translation: 不，我沒看到。

scripts.text:
[Semangat's Wife]
He ran away when
I was looking for him.
Should be somewhere, telling tall tales
to some travelers, like always.
scripts.translation:
[塞曼加特的妻子]
我找他時，他又跑掉了。
肯定又在給那些旅行者講那些吹牛的故事，就像往常一樣。

scripts.text:
[Semangat's Wife]
I apologize
on behalf of my husband.
Please don't believe his foolish stories
saying he met with ^FF0000Monkeys and Snakes^000000, or
that he fought alongside a ^FF0000Cuttlefish^000000.
scripts.translation:
[塞曼加特的妻子]
請替我丈夫向你們道歉。
請不要相信他那些胡話，
說什麼他遇到了^FF0000猴子和蛇^000000，
或者和^FF0000烏賊^000000並肩作戰。

scripts.text:
[Semangat's Wife]
He has been living here
for entire life.
Yet, always find some travelers,
and who will listen to his made-up tales.
scripts.translation:
[塞曼加特的妻子]
他在這裡住了一輩子。
卻總是能找到一些願意聽他編造故事的旅行者。

scripts.text:
[Semangat's Wife]
Oh. Please let me know
if you ever see him around.
scripts.translation:
[塞曼加特的妻子]
哦。如果你看到他，請告訴我一聲。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
Isn't ^8B4513Dewata^000000 beach
really beautiful?
The children always play
at this beach. It really
reminds me of my youth.
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
^8B4513德瓦他^000000的海灘
真的很美，不是嗎？
孩子們總喜歡在這個海灘玩耍。
這真讓我想起了我的青春歲月。

scripts.text:
[Young Man]
At the evening, you can see
fireworks from the beach.
With ocean breeze, the crashing waves,
and fireworks lighting the sky,
the nighttime is a time of beauty here!
scripts.translation:
[年輕男子]
傍晚時分，你可以從海灘上看到煙花。
伴隨著海風、拍岸的浪花，
以及照亮夜空的煙花，
這裡的夜晚真是美不勝收！

scripts.text:
[Young Lady]
When you are outside of the town,
and meet ^FF0000Tiger, Monkey, or pig^000000,
make sure to avoid them.
scripts.translation:
[年輕女士]
如果你在城外，
遇到了^FF0000老虎、猴子或野豬^000000，
一定要避開它們。

scripts.text: What do you mean?
scripts.translation: 你這是什麼意思？

scripts.text:
[Young Lady]
I haven't seen yet,
but legend says there's a
cruel monster named ^FF0000Leak^000000
which can transform into an animal
and hypnotize people into killing.
scripts.translation:
[年輕女士]
我還沒見過，
但傳說有一種名叫^FF0000讓特^000000的殘忍魔物，
它能變成動物，
並催眠人們去殺人。

scripts.text:
[Young Lady]
You know the dangers of this world.
It's never hurts to be careful
even if it's just an urban legend.
scripts.translation:
[年輕女士]
你知道這個世界的危險。
即使那只是都市傳說，
小心一點總沒錯。

scripts.text:
[Settler]
I'm not really from ^8B4513Dewata^000000.
But while traveling,
I found this place...
And made my decision
to live in this beautiful town.
scripts.translation:
[定居者]
我並不是^8B4513德瓦他^000000本地人。
但在旅行途中，
我發現了這個地方...
並決定在這座美麗的城鎮定居。

scripts.text:
[Settler]
I've been happy to live here
and to find and experience
all these beautiful sights.
It's a dream come true.
scripts.translation:
[定居者]
我很高興能住在這裡，
發現並體驗
所有這些美麗的風景。
這簡直是夢想成真。

scripts.text:
[Settler]
Would you ever think of
settling here too?
scripts.translation:
[定居者]
你會考慮在這裡定居嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dieting Lady]
Ah~ I'm starving!!
I should be on a diet now.
Why am I still hungry?
scripts.translation:
[節食的女士]
啊~我餓死了！！
我現在應該在節食。
為什麼我還是這麼餓？

scripts.text:
[Dieting Lady]
Don't talk to me too much!!
I want to try that grilled ^006400Satay^000000
so much~!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[節食的女士]
別跟我說話！！
我好想吃那個烤^006400沙嗲^000000
啊~!!!!!

scripts.text:
[Dieting Lady]
Is that mouth-watering
^006400Satay^000000 for me?
scripts.translation:
[節食的女士]
那個讓人垂涎欲滴的
^006400沙嗲^000000是給我的嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, want a taste?
scripts.translation: 是的，想嚐嚐嗎？

scripts.text: No, it's for me!
scripts.translation: 不，那是給我自己的！

scripts.text:
[Dieting Lady]
Thanks so much!
I've been so hungry~!!
This smell of this ^006400Satay^000000
is so good~!
scripts.translation:
[節食的女士]
太感謝了！
我餓死了~！！
這^006400沙嗲^000000的香味
真是太棒了~！

scripts.text:
[Dieting Lady]
Ah... gotta come back to my senses,
too much of a good thing is bad...
I should stick with my diet.
Sorry, I'll give it back to you.
scripts.translation:
[節食的女士]
啊...我得清醒一下，
過猶不及...
我還是得堅持節食。
抱歉，還給你。

scripts.text:
[Dieting Lady]
Arrgg.. You are so greedy!
Since you don't want to share.
Anyway, I shouldn't cheat on my diet
even for something that looks and smells so good...
scripts.translation:
[節食的女士]
啊...你太貪心了！
既然你不願意分享。
不過，即使面對如此美味且香噴噴的東西，
我也不應該違揹我的節食計劃...

scripts.text:
[Dreaming Kid]
My granny says
There was once a bird named ^FF0000Garuda^000000
who flew above this town.
Afterwards we had some great harvests
and were able to live happily.
scripts.translation:
[做夢的孩子]
老奶奶說，
曾經有一隻名叫^FF0000迦樓羅^000000的鳥
飛過這座城鎮的上空。
之後我們迎來了大豐收，
過上了幸福的生活。

scripts.text:
[Dreaming Kid]
I want to see that bird
flying above our town again!
Then my mom, dad
granny, and grandpa
can be happy like the old times.
What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[做夢的孩子]
我想再次看到那隻鳥
飛過我們城鎮的上空！
那樣媽媽、爸爸、
老奶奶和老爺爺
就能像以前一樣幸福了。
你覺得呢？

scripts.text:
[Energetic Kid]
My parents used to tell me...
scripts.translation:
[活潑的孩子]
我的父母以前常對我說...

scripts.text:
- ^006400Son,^000000 -
- ^006400You should study hard.^000000 -
- ^006400Be happy.^000000 -
- ^006400Live a slow^000000 -
- ^006400and safe life.^000000 -
- ^006400The mountain over yonder^000000 -
- ^006400will always be there for you.^000000 -

[Energetic Kid]
Isn't it a great philosophy?
I want to live that way
and become a great person,
and help all of the people in our town
live happily ever after!
scripts.translation:
[活潑的孩子]
這難道不是一種很棒的人生哲學嗎？
我想這樣生活，
成為一個偉大的人，
並幫助我們城鎮裡的所有人
永遠幸福地生活下去！

scripts.text:
[Kid wishing to be an adult]
My family has been brewing
traditional Dewata wine for ages.
I want to drink it myself,
but my dad says I'm too young.
He said I can drink it
only after I sleep for over ^FF0000100 days^000000.
scripts.translation:
[想當大人的孩子]
我家世代釀造
傳統的德瓦他酒。
我想自己嚐嚐，
但爸爸說我還太小。
他說只有在我睡了^FF0000100天^000000之後
才能喝。

scripts.text:
[Kid wishing to be an adult]
All grown-ups love to drink
my dad's wine.
I want to try some so bad.
But, what should I do...?
I've forgotten how many ^FF0000nights^000000
I've already slept... boo hoo!
scripts.translation:
[想當大人的孩子]
所有大人都喜歡喝
爸爸釀的酒。
我好想嚐嚐啊。
但是，我該怎麼做呢...？
我忘了自己已經睡了^FF0000多少夜^000000了...嗚嗚！

scripts.text:
[Jaty Tribe Gatekeeper]
Welcome to ^FF0000Jaty^000000 town.
Our tribe reveres strength and bravery.
We wish you a safe and restful time here.
scripts.translation:
[雅提部落守門人]
歡迎來到^FF0000雅提^000000鎮。
我們的部落崇尚力量與勇氣。
祝您在此度過安全而安寧的時光。

scripts.text:
[Reserved Jaty Warrior]
I want to be the very best
like no one ever was.
scripts.translation:
[沉默寡言的雅提戰士]
我要成為無人能及的
最強者。

scripts.text:
[Reserved Jaty Warrior]
I'm learning hunting skills
these days. And I'm getting
better and better
every day!
scripts.translation:
[沉默寡言的雅提戰士]
我最近正在學習狩獵技巧。
而且我每天都在
變得更強！

scripts.text:
[Reserved Jaty Warrior]
I won't stop until
I become a true warrior!
scripts.translation:
[沉默寡言的雅提戰士]
在成為真正的戰士之前，
我絕不會停下腳步！
